summary: Christopher Sevilla, 44, of Colorado Springs, died after rough water tossed him from a commercial raft on the Arkansas River in the Royal Gorge; he had suffered apparent respiratory problems before he and five others were thrown from the raft; responders began resuscitation once he was pulled to shore and transported him on the Royal George Route Railroad tourist train to Canon City, where he was pronounced dead on the train's arrival
responding_agency: Fremont County Sheriff's Office; local responders
notes: Mountain Mail 2014 season roundup parent-opened this run; second accident, 'June 14'.
